name: Evangeline Sublime
source:
You wake up in a supposed hospital room where strangers surround you. The air is tense, and you have no idea how you ended up there. You all are trapped and being used for your supernatural abilities. Will you make new friends? Escape? Or will another undeniable truth be right for you? 

[From [url=https://bluebosnian.itch.io/evangeline-sublime]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个所谓的病房里醒来，周围都是陌生人。空气很紧张，你不知道自己是怎么到那里的。你们都被困住并被利用你们的超自然能力。你会结交新朋友吗？逃脱？或者另一个不可否认的事实适合你吗？

[来自[url=https://bluebosnian.itch.io/evangeline-sublime]itch.io[/url]]
